title: She Fell 33,330 Feet Without a Parachute — and Lived
script: January 26, 1972. Flight attendant Vesna Vulović is working JAT Flight 367 over Czechoslovakia. At 33,330 feet, the plane breaks apart. Twenty-seven people die. Vesna falls. No parachute. A villager finds her in the wreckage, still alive. Skull, legs, spine. All broken. She survives. And Guinness still lists it as the highest fall ever survived without a parachute.
